free_tier.stated: Marketed as 'unlimit drive'; free registered users get unlimited file count with a 500 MB per-file ceiling for private files. No numeric total quota published.

retention.stated: Retention: 1 month inactive for unregistered, 3 months registered, 5 months premium

egress.terms: Free downloads speed-limited ('We need to limit download speed for keep our servers online 24/7'); no GB cap published.

tooling: Documented API: GET /api/server/available returns {url, serverAccessToken}; POST {url} multipart with serverAccessToken (+ optional X-AUTH-TOKEN for account uploads).
chaining: Anonymous uploads allowed without X-AUTH-TOKEN, so unlimited identities x 500 MB/file. 500 MB per file is the binding constraint; you would shard.
limits_note: 500 MB per file for anonymous/private; larger downloads require a registered account. Retention: 1 month inactive for unregistered, 3 months registered, 5 months premium. TTL grows with downloads/plays.
reliability_note: The upload nodes themselves were unreachable — hs6/hs7/hs12.krakencloud.net failed to connect on 443 after 21s — so the API is currently broken in practice, not just rate-limited. Speed-limited downloads.

evidence.proved: 'maximum size of the user's private files cannot exceed 500MB'; anonymous users 'may not ... download files exceeding 500MB'
'not been downloaded for at least 1 month for non-register user, 3 months register users and 5 month for premium'
